Core Flow

Player Cheat Sheet: Core Flow

1) Core Roll

  • Roll: Attribute d8
  • Keep: Mastery Rank
  • Explode: natural 8 (natural 7–8 on a designated Critical roll)
  • Guaranteed Eight: exchange 8 Pool dice for 1 exploding 8; it counts as one result in the final Pool
  • Result: sum of kept dice

Most rolls use:

Attribute k MR

Example: Might 8, MR 3 = 8k3

2) Skill Checks

The GM sets the Challenge MR from the target, opposition, creator, item, scene, Power, Ritual target, or obstacle.

Standard TN: (8 × Challenge MR) − 2

The GM may adjust the TN in ±4 steps.

Skill Points

  • Spend after seeing the roll.
  • Spend from one fitting Skill only.
  • Spend 0, at least MR, then more in MR steps, or go all-in.
  • Refresh after a Safe Haven Rest.

Full Pool Rule

  • Skill Rating must be at least 2 × MR.
  • If lower, roll half Attribute Pool, rounded down.
  • Roll the final Pool after reductions. Keep at most MR dice; if fewer remain, keep all. A Pool of 0 fails.

3) Raises

Combat Raises - Universal Catalog

Before an eligible Attack or Casting Roll, declare Paid Raises (+4 TN each). On success, spend each Raise using the Universal Combat Raise Catalog: +MR d8 Damage (AoE: +ceil(MR/2) d8) or +MR to an existing numeric Special. All deliveries use the same values. Intellect Free Raises use this catalog without raising TN. A Split Attack has one Raise choice for its entire Power use.

The raised TN is the only success threshold for the affected target. A Casting Roll below Spell Base TN fizzles; meeting Spell Base TN but missing a target's raised Final Spell TN means that target resists the Spell.

Ritual Raises

Ritual Raises are declared before rolling.

Each declared Ritual Raise increases the required Ritual Raise TN by +4.

Pay and Seal the full Stone cost of the declared Ritual Raise Level before rolling.

  • Below the Base Ritual TN, the Ritual fails.
  • If the result meets the Base Ritual TN but misses the Ritual Raise TN, apply only the Raise 0 effect. The full declared Stone cost remains Sealed.
  • If the result meets the Ritual Raise TN, apply the declared Raise effect and all lower Raise effects.

Only declared Ritual Raises can take effect. Extra margin does not unlock undeclared Raise Levels.

Echo Cards

Echo Card Raises are counted after the roll unless the card says otherwise. Every full +4 over TN equals 1 Raise.

4) Round & Turn

Each Round, every creature gets one Turn.

At the start of each Round, you normally have:

  • 1 Movement
  • 1 Attack Action
  • 1 Reaction

On your Turn, use Movement and uncommitted Attack Actions in either order. A base Action paid for a Buff in Preparation is unavailable; legal extra Attack Actions remain.

A Reaction is used outside your Turn when its trigger happens.

5) Power Use Limit

A specific Power can be used only once per round.

After you use a Power, it is spent until the start of the next round.

Power identity is determined by the base Technical Reference, not by the character-facing name, source, current PL, or Martial/Spell delivery.

This applies to Actives, Active Buffs, Reactions, Movement Powers, and other named Power effects.

Extra Attack Actions, Reactions, or Movements do not let you repeat the same Power.

The same Reaction cannot be used more than once per Round unless that Reaction explicitly allows repeated uses. Each repeated use still costs 1 Reaction.

Additional Attack Actions from different sources do not add together unless a rule explicitly says otherwise; use the highest single grant.

Basic Attacks are not Powers and may be repeated if you have enough Attack Actions.

6) Initiative

Initiative is rolled once at the start of combat.

Roll:

MR d8, keep all

8s explode.

Initiative Score = Initiative Roll + Initiative modifiers

The Initiative Score remains in play until it is spent or another rule changes it.

Initiative is not rolled again each Round unless a rule explicitly allows it.

7) Initiative Exchange

At the start of each Round, before anyone moves or acts:

  1. On the first Round only, roll Initiative.
  2. Initiative Boost may be activated now, once per combat.
  3. Convert Initiative into Initiative Colorless Stones at 4 × MR Initiative per Stone.
  4. Determine Initiative Order from the remaining scores and lock it for the Round.
MR Cost per Stone
2 8
3 12
4 16
5 20
6 24
7 28
8 32

Initiative cannot drop below 0 and is not reset between Rounds. Each creature still gets only one Turn per Round.

Initiative Colorless Stones may pay normal costs for unlocked Stone Abilities. When spent, they become Exhausted, but can be restored through normal Stone Recovery only when selected by Influence: Colorless Recovery. They disappear when combat ends and cannot be burned, Sealed, or Bound.
